compiler_source_hash_policy: Installed .py/.mjs files with canonical LF line endings

compression.archive: canonical USTAR then gzip level 9, mtime 0
compression.per_file: gzip level 9, mtime 0; excludes HTTP headers

methods.build: Warm imported compiler and Unicode repr table; compilation and manifest generation only; excludes filesystem writes and Python startup.
methods.cold: Fresh browser context and worker per sample; browser process and OS caches remain warm/uncontrolled. Timer covers worker creation, imports, initialization, one call and result message; excludes document navigation.
methods.memory: Separate fresh-context worker samples. CDP HeapProfiler.collectGarbage then Runtime.getHeapUsage before import and after retaining one module/result. Used/total V8 heap, embedder heap and backing storage are bytes; excludes process RSS, other processes, and native/code allocations not exposed by this API.
methods.scope: Synchronous compiled-module browser fixtures, including measurement harness, maps/notices/manifest. Browser-host SDK and pocket PWA shell are measured separately. All-profile baseline includes every helper valid for the same profile; no new feature is enabled.
methods.warm: One context, explicit untimed warm-up, then a fresh worker for each observation. HTTP cache is shared; code-cache reuse is browser-controlled.
